name: RCE Capital Berhad
overview: 2026年，RCE Capital Berhad 的公告主要涉及员工股份计划（ESOS）的设立与新股发行、向客户提供财务援助，以及派发中期股息；没有公告显示业务板块出现扩张、新增、缩减或出售。最新一季（2026-06-30）营收同比减少1.8%，净利润同比增长17.1%。
overview_en: In 2026, RCE Capital Berhad's announcements mainly covered the establishment of an employees' share scheme (ESOS) and new share issuances, the provision of financial assistance to customers, and interim dividend declarations; no announcements indicated expansion, new business, reduction, or disposal of any business segment. In the latest quarter (30 June 2026), revenue decreased 1.8% year-on-year while net profit increased 17.1% year-on-year.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年公告涉及员工股份计划、新股发行、财务援助及股息派发，未提及具体业务板块的扩张或缩减。
segments.note_en: This year's announcements covered the employees' share scheme, new share issuances, financial assistance and dividend payments, with no mention of expansion or reduction in specific business segments.
